BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.
   B. Treat Insurance as rumours only.
   C. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.
   C. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

5. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.
   C. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.
   B. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.

7. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.
   C. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.
   D. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Foreign Exchange Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Foreign Exchange Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Foreign Exchange Markets never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Foreign Exchange Markets as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Foreign Exchange Markets.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

10. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   B. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   C. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.

12. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   C. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Cash Flow Statement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain End - Of - Year Adjustments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Insurance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Foreign Exchange Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
